decision_rules: Passports belong to executable identities, not repositories, UIs, libraries, deployment shells, or connectors.
Demo/mock passport records are not accepted as issued passports.
Duplicate-looking identities are consolidated when repository evidence indicates one subject across multiple runtimes.
Owner authorization is recorded, but activation still requires runtime/public-key binding, canonical registration, issuer signature, and receipt.
